name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck ordering & kitchen system
promotionalText: Take orders in advance, stop orders going beyond what the kitchen can handle, and keep doing business when the signal cuts out. The ordering app made for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app made for food trucks: your team relies on it to handle the whole service period.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on the same screen, confirm which ones the kitchen can cook, then mark them ready for collection and collected.

[Don't promise a time you can't make]
Set how much the kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a collection time is full, customers can't choose it, so the queued orders match what the kitchen can do.

[Take orders on the spot at the window]
Add walk-up orders on the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen only has to follow one queue.

[One screen just for the kitchen]
The kitchen display lists the orders to make now, the next one to make and those ready for collection, and gives an alert when an order needs to start being made.

[Print kitchen tickets]
Connect the kitchen receipt printer via Bluetooth or local network and kitchen tickets print automatically.

[No signal? Keep doing business]
With offline order protection switched on, if the connection drops, pre-ordering pauses so nobody places an order you can't see. Orders you take on the device are kept and sync once the connection is back.

[Made for food trucks]
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

[Plan your week]
Set up your events and locations in one go, then take orders for each event.

HatchGrab is made for food truck operators and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to log in.
